name: Crotch Bumble Bee
desc: Crotch Bumble Bee (Bombus crotchii): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bombus crotchii, commonly called Crotch's bumble bee or the Golden State bumble bee, is a species of bumblebee named after the entomologist George Robert Crotch.
